test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 26 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Pranit starts from Point A and drives 27 km towards West. He then takes a left turn, drives 17 km, turns left and drives 14 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 10 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 13 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again?

(All turns are 90 degree turns only unless otherwise specified.)
solution:
Given:

Pranit starts from Point A and drives 27 km towards West.

He then takes a left turn, drives 17 km, turns left and drives 14 km.

He then takes a left turn and drives 10 km.

He takes a final right turn, drives 13 km and stops at Point P. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/02ba37b819136561d336d6328e228df934b977335edb3096545cfe7ebae7e2d1.png] 

Thus, Pranit should drive (17 km - 10 km) 7 km in the north direction in order to reach Point A again.

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
